subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Static Electricity: Charge at Rest
description: Learn Static Electricity: Charge at Rest in one minute.

hook.text: Rub a balloon on your hair and it sticks to the wall. That's static charge.

buildup.text: Friction transfers electrons from one surface to another. One gains, one loses.

discovery.text: The imbalance creates a voltage difference. Opposite charges attract.

twist.text: Lightning is static discharge on a massive scale — billions of volts.

climax.text: Static can destroy microchips. Factories ground workers to prevent damage.

punchline.text: Charge at rest is harmless — until it jumps.

quiz.question: What causes static electricity?
options: Magnetic fields pull electrons from atoms
Friction transfers electrons between surfaces, creating charge imbalance
Heat causes electrons to vibrate and escape their atoms
